Class FormBinding

java.lang.Object
io.micronaut.http.server.binding.FormBinding
@Internal public final class FormBinding extends Object
How the arguments of a route read the form of a request, decided once per request from the arguments of the route, so that it does not depend on their order.
  • Fields, when the route has no FormData and no FormParts argument: each argument reads the fields of its name through the FormRouteCompleter, like CompletedFileUpload arguments. A FileUpload (or a List of them) is received and stored before the route runs, a FormPart is handed over as its content starts to arrive, like a StreamingFileUpload. The fields no argument asks for are discarded.
  • Collected, when the route has a FormData argument: the whole form is read once, and the FileUpload arguments and the text arguments of the form (a Part or a parameter bound by name) are taken from it; a FileUpload argument is the handle FormData.getFile(String) returns.
  • Streamed, when the route has a FormParts argument: the parts read the whole form as it arrives. A parameter that is not annotated is not bound from the form.

Refused, before anything reads the form, with an IllegalStateException that names the arguments (answered with 500): a FormData with a FormParts; a FormData with an argument that reads its field by itself (a FormPart or a type of io.micronaut.http.multipart); a FormParts with any argument that reads a form field (a Part, a FileUpload, a FormPart or a type of io.micronaut.http.multipart). This is not a compile-time check: when a filter replaces the body of the request, every argument is bound from the form it set and nothing is refused.

5.3.0

    • bindReplaced

      public static <T> @Nullable ArgumentBinder.BindingResult<T> bindReplaced(ArgumentConversionContext<T> context, HttpRequest<?> source, ConversionService conversionService, String name)
      Bind an argument that is taken from the form of a request whose body a filter set, see ServerRequestBody.isBodySet(HttpRequest): a FileUpload, a List<FileUpload>, an Optional of one, or a text field by name. A body set to null is a form without fields, and a body set to a FormData (or an object that converts to one) is that form; the bytes of the request are never read. A FormPart cannot be streamed from it.
      Type Parameters:
      T - The type of the argument
      Parameters:
      context - The conversion context of the argument
      source - The request the argument is bound from
      conversionService - The conversion service
      name - The name of the field
      Returns:
      The binding result, or null if no filter set the body of a form request
